title: Portfolio
summary: This portfolio brings together projects, writing, and my CV in a static site.

paths.title: Substack → writing
paths.description: The build caches the public RSS feed and renders articles into the writing index.

paths.title: Local drafting
paths.description: An optional Ollama task proposes article descriptions. Drafts stay local for review.

relations.title: Web tooling
relations.description: Both projects use HTML, CSS and JavaScript in the browser.

contract.artifact: Shared HTML, CSS and JavaScript conventions.
contract.transfer: The portfolio builds static files. The marketplace runs a Fastify server with PGlite.
contract.result: A published portfolio and a local booking prototype.
contract.boundary: Each has its own build and runtime. They exchange no application data.

title: Swarm Studio
summary: A local workspace for planning research missions, assigning tasks, and reviewing collected sources.

paths.title: Export captured source material
paths.description: A mission can export browser captures and source notes in a portable evidence bundle.

paths.title: Keep the workspaces independent
paths.description: Receiving tools read a chosen export file; they do not connect to the running agent workspace.

relations.title: Evidence bundle → knowledge drafts
relations.description: Support Studio can turn selected research captures into knowledge drafts.

contract.artifact: Swarm browser-evidence JSON or the same file inside a mission ZIP.
contract.transfer: An operator exports a mission, previews the import, and chooses which captures to commit to a business workspace.
contract.result: Knowledge drafts with source IDs for review.
contract.boundary: A reviewer must verify each draft before it can inform support answers.
contract.evidence: Synthetic Swarm exports passed through the real importer in both JSON and ZIP form.

relations.title: Evidence bundle → source manifest
relations.description: The gateway's offline importer turns the same Swarm export into source cards for hardware research.

contract.artifact: Swarm browser-evidence JSON or the same file inside a mission ZIP.
contract.transfer: The gateway validates the selected file with the same portable validator used by Support Studio.
contract.result: A versioned JSON manifest with unreviewed source cards.
contract.boundary: Modem, operator, two-way audio and capacity qualification require separate physical tests.
contract.evidence: Synthetic JSON and ZIP imports preserved the source ID and left every hardware qualification flag unset.

title: THESUS
summary: A shared Chromium workspace where a person can review proposed browser actions, take over, and see a local history of decisions.

paths.title: Decisions and checkpoints
paths.description: The browser workspace keeps a local event history for human review.

paths.title: Own history format
paths.description: The local event history is separate from the dataset and research export formats used by the other tools.

relations.title: Browser history → review dataset
relations.description: A proposed adapter would let an operator review selected browser history as dataset candidates.

contract.artifact: Selected records from the local THESUS browser history.
contract.transfer: Redact the selected records and translate them to the manual event schema accepted by Data OSINT.
contract.result: Candidates for review. Approved examples could enter a versioned JSONL evaluation dataset.
contract.boundary: The adapter and redaction review are still needed. Data OSINT currently accepts its documented archive formats.

title: Data OSINT
summary: A local tool for searching authorized AI session archives and building human-reviewed evaluation datasets.

paths.title: Supported archive import
paths.description: The CLI reads selected Codex, OpenCode, and manual archives using separate format adapters.

paths.title: Review → dataset export
paths.description: Accepted examples can be frozen into a versioned JSONL dataset after explicit review.

relations.title: Local review workflows
relations.description: Both are Python command-line tools with human review and traceable local records.

contract.artifact: Data OSINT exports reviewed JSONL examples. ASTIG accepts a claim and source snapshots.
contract.transfer: The tools follow separate review workflows and exchange no files.
contract.result: An evaluation dataset from Data OSINT and verdict receipts from ASTIG.
contract.boundary: Any future integration would need to construct an explicit claim and source snapshots.

title: ASTIG
summary: A local pilot that records evidence for and against a claim, groups duplicate sources, and returns a traceable verdict for review.

paths.title: Source snapshots → verdict receipt
paths.description: The pilot records source IDs and offsets so a reviewer can retrace how a verdict was formed.

paths.title: An explicit input schema
paths.description: It needs an operator-prepared claim and source snapshot file, not a stream of agent events.

title: Support Studio
summary: A local customer-service desk for reviewing cases, approved knowledge, and examples for evaluation.

paths.title: Human approval before reuse
paths.description: Imported captures start as knowledge drafts. A reviewer decides what the support workflow can use.

paths.title: Browser-first pilot
paths.description: The desk supports a person working in the browser. It has no live phone connection.

relations.title: Support desk → live calls
relations.description: A proposed voice bridge would connect the browser support desk to calls through the gateway.

contract.artifact: Call events and two-way audio from a future voice bridge.
contract.transfer: A voice adapter would connect the support desk to a qualified gateway.
contract.result: A potential operator workflow for live calls.
contract.boundary: The voice adapter and physical audio tests are pending. The existing Swarm file handoffs carry research evidence only.

title: DIY Phone Gateway
summary: A blueprint and Python tools for planning and checking a local phone gateway.

paths.title: Offline planning tools
paths.description: The prototype produces planning outputs and supports local hardware inventory checks.

paths.title: Hardware tests pending
paths.description: There is no live voice bridge or confirmed concurrent call capacity.

title: 7erfa w Bricole
summary: A Morocco-first home-services marketplace prototype with a synthetic request-to-completion flow.

paths.title: Request → match → quote
paths.description: The local demo connects client, provider, and pilot-team screens using fictional data.

paths.title: Pilot constraints
paths.description: Onboarding and payments are simulated; the prototype is designed to run on the local machine.
